original.statement: The USERS.md documentation file was updated to add pollinate to the list of known Argo CD users.

decision.reason: [ev-7a46c2eb34a1] only shows a changelog entry under "Other work" that adds pollinate to USERS.md. That is a documentation edit to the list of adopters. It changes no configuration, API, flag, image or behaviour, so no customer environment is exposed to anything. The proposed exposure flags every environment upgrading from below 3.0.0, which is far broader than the evidence supports. No valid exposure condition follows, because this is not an operational change.
